title: Scan Mini source tokens
description: The Lexer reads characters, skips comments, and returns typed tokens for the parser.

steps.description: LexError reports a source line. Lexer tracks source text, its current position, and its current line while peek and advance read characters.
Whitespace is consumed. A # comment is consumed through its newline.
The number reader consumes digits and an optional decimal part, then returns a NUMBER token.
The string reader handles quoted text and listed escapes. The identifier reader uses KEYWORDS to distinguish keywords from identifiers.
next_token chooses literal readers first, checks two-character operators before single-character operators, and raises LexError for an unexpected character.
tokenize repeatedly appends tokens until it receives EOF.
